description: Look up an IPv4 or IPv6 address's basics, network owner (ASN, name and country), blocklist status and IP profile URL. Detailed evidence, source dates and related websites are on the linked profile. Uses local data only; never connects to the address or queues a scan. Blocklist status currently covers Spamhaus ASN-DROP: listed, not_listed or not_assessed. It assesses the entire network, and absence does not prove safety. Accepts a bare IP address; use check_website for domains or URLs.

ip.description: A bare IPv4 or IPv6 address, without a URL, port, CIDR prefix or zone identifier.

name: check_ip

blocklist_status.description: listed, not_listed or not_assessed, from our local Spamhaus ASN-DROP snapshot. This checks the whole network; not_listed does not prove the IP is safe.

ip.description: The canonical IPv4 or IPv6 address.

network.description: Network owner; omitted if unavailable, unmatched or not applicable.

country_code.description: Network country from IPtoASN, not the device's location; may be empty or None.

report_url.description: The full IP profile, including source dates and related websites.

title: Look up IP evidence
